messages:
maya: FYI oncall hit an odd case: they pinned traffic to primary during an autofallback and later the rollout timeline still showed fallback active. caused confusion.

todd: hmm we currently set override flag but don't emit a discrete transition event. console reconciles state from autos and last-trigger which can hide operator actions.

kai: UX idea: render operator overrides as explicit timeline events (colored segment + pill). pill shows actor, ttl, reason, and has undo/extend.

maya: need auditable + replayable evidence too. we couldn't replay decision path because policy snapshot wasn't stored.

jordana: we should emit a replay_token and persist a policy_snapshot_id for operator actions. always store full snapshot for manual overrides. ops-bot: replay-token rt-1745800000 created.

todd: telemetry shape: emit rollout_transition events: type, actor, reason, from, to, ttl_seconds, policy_snapshot_id, replay_token.

kai: default TTL? propose 60m with presets 15m/1h/4h/indefinite. require reason when >2h or indefinite.

jordana: to avoid flip-flop add cooldown: while override active autos won't switch unless override-escape thresholds met (configurable). default escape: error_rate>0.25 OR p95>3s.

todd: API: POST /api/v1/rollouts/:id/override { actor, reason, ttl_seconds } returns replay_token. POST /api/v1/rollouts/:id/replay { replay_token } to run in sandbox.

maya: action items: todd estimate storage & API changes, jordana draft audit schema + replay flow, kai mock pill + timeline, i will bake TTL defaults into runbook. target: spec by EOD Wed.

ops-bot: note created: override-forensics-1745800000.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
